name: Critical Bad End 4 -The Reviving Nightmare-
source:
The power, the grotesque, the hopelessness.
When the nightmare strikes anew, the girls' power isn't enough.
Humiliation awaits each and every crushed angel.

The ending is worse than imaginable. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE120030.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
力量、怪诞、绝望。
当噩梦再次袭来，女孩们的力量仍然不够。
每一位被击溃的天使都将迎来屈辱。

结局比想象中更加糟糕。

[来自 [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE120030.html]DLsite英文页面[/url]]
